title: Bombs without brakes? US-China AI race may be harder to control than the nuclear one

Billionaire Elon Musk has called AI “far more dangerous than nukes.” Anthropic boss Dario Amodei describes the most powerful models as “weaponisable nuclear materials.” Sam Altman, when asked how AI could be policed, often points to the International Atomic Energy Agency(IAEA), the world's nuclear watchdog.

title: Trump announces $200bn South Korean investment in US, $54bn for Alaska LNG

This ambitious plan encompasses a critical liquefied natural gas project in Alaska and a gas-fired power facility in Texas. Moreover, investments in eight nuclear reactors across the nation are also underway. These strategic ventures stem from a $350 billion trade agreement signed in November 2025, reinforcing economic cooperation between South Korea and the US.

title: In 2018, Musk gave $480,350 for Flint school filters; students drink from fountains

Students were previously reliant on bottled water for drinking due to contamination concerns. Testing confirmed that the new systems effectively removed lead and harmful bacteria from the water supply. Although drinking stations are now available, bottled water will continue to be provided throughout the school year.

title: After two Asian Games medals, Harita Bhadra sets her sights on 22.45s and World Championships
content: Harita Bhadra arrived at the Asian Games chasing a podium finish and left Nagoya with two bronze medals, in the women’s 200m and mixed 4x100m relay. Her first senior international competition has also sharpened the next target: a 22.45-second run, the qualifying mark for the 2027 World Championships. Bhadra reflects on the races, the mental lessons from Nagoya, her relay experience and why she believes the next level is within reach.

title: Iowa developer's $11M mall plan stalled by 50-year-old JCPenney lease

This ambitious mixed-use development aims to blend residential, retail, and entertainment spaces. Yet, they must navigate a challenging lease agreement with JCPenney that could impede progress. City officials are contemplating up to $110 million in public funding for this expansive project, with hopes of commencing construction following city approvals and finalized site plans.

title: 1,000+ acre Loudoun estate with Potomac frontage listed for $41.5M

The offering includes Potomac River frontage, vineyards, farmland and a historic 1700s house across two tracts. The land has been placed under conservation easements, while the properties offer potential for residential, agricultural and hospitality uses.

title: Michael & Susan Dell’s Foundation pledges $36.6 million for 1,400 Austin homes

The expansion aims to accommodate up to 1,900 residents experiencing chronic homelessness while adding 127 acres to the site. Infrastructure work is expected to begin in 2023 across properties along Hog Eye Road and Burleson Road. This development is part of a broader campaign to support affordable and permanent housing needs.

The zoo is dedicated to wildlife education and conservation, enticing visitors with outdoor experiences. After quarantine, Tejas will share his habitat with Bhola, the Royal Bengal tiger, offering wildlife enthusiasts an opportunity to explore the beauty of nature.

Their strategy includes widespread protests and a pivotal 'Save Democracy March' to elevate public consciousness while pressuring for essential reforms. Additionally, the bloc intends to approach the Supreme Court about ongoing electoral challenges. Among their key proposals are reinstating ballot voting and refining voter registration methods.

The 41-year-old has not announced his international retirement, but said he would reveal the reasons for his decision “in due time.”

Their remarkable achievements earned them the Nobel Prize in Chemistry, and future expansions may enhance the reach of this technology.

content: a bench expressed difficulty to list the matter on Thursday and said, 'Instead of Thursday, we will dismiss the appeal on Monday' the appeal against grant of interim bail to Milan Pradhan, an accused in a 2007 murder case, would be over and the state's appeal would be infructuous .

title: Pahalgam massacre mastermind Musa killed; entire LeT commander group wiped out
content: mohammad asif, alias Hashim Musa, was killed in an overnight encounter in the upper reaches of Yousmarg, around 60km from Srinagar . the entire group of four leT commanders who had been operating in J&K since 2022 has been wiped out .

title: India’s growth must benefit next generation, says Union minister Kiren Rijiju
content: india is the fastest growing major economy in the world . the challenge is to extend that growth and pass on its benefits to the next generation, says the union minister of parliamentary affairs and minority affairs Kiren Rijiju . "if there are people who are not feeling part of the growth story, then it is our duty as a part of govt to bring them along," he said .

title: ‘Might as well disband you’: SC slams UP police for cover-up job

title: Amid SIR row, INDIA bloc puts up united front, targets PM Modi, Shah
content: the opposition inDIA bloc announced a month-long nationwide agitation starting Oct 2-8 . the opposition collectively demanded that elections should revert to ballot papers . it also sought an effective appeals mechanism for voters excluded from the rolls .

title: Captain Machchhar: The pilot from Mumbai who proved to be the hero
